 PROFILE SUMMARY 
 
• Developed and implemented a comprehensive sustainability/ ESG framework for sustainable 
financial investment, evaluating and benchmarking a number of companies on the same for ESG 
risk and mitigation 
• Developed training modules and implemented a Knowledge management system for training of 
independent directors for Shiv Nadar University 
• Successfully managed and executed multiple consultancy projects , delivering valuable 
insights and recommendations to clients in diverse sectors, including renewable energy, 
manufacturing, agriculture, technology, MSME and finance 
• Led a team in conducting in-depth research and analysis  on governance, sustainability and 
public policy, enabling the identification of risks, opportunities and implementation issues 
• Successfully collaborated with government bodies, including NITI Aayog and the Ministry of 
Corporate Affairs, MSME, Social Justice and Empowerment to work and shape policy 
initiatives and advocate for good governance, sustainability and public policy practices 
• Designed and executed a governance, whistleblower and fraud risk management program  
for a multinational organization, resulting in enhanced corporate governance, better fraud 
risk and reputation management   
• Established strategic partnerships with industry bodies such as ASSOCHAM, FICCI, and CII to 
drive collective action on governance and sustainability issues and promote responsible 
business practices 
• Published books, books chapters, academic papers, influential reports and thought 
leadership articles on governance, sustainability and ESG topics, contributing to knowledge 
and shaping the discourse on responsible business and better governance 
• Conducted offline & online  teaching/training/workshops for working & aspiring 
professionals, and senior management on governance, business ethics, fraud risk, and 
sustainability equipping them with the knowledge and tools to integrate into business 
strategies 
• Collaborated with multilateral organizations such  as UK DFID, GIZ of Germany, and the UN 
Global Compact Network to support sustainable development initiatives and promote cross -
sector collaboration
